mapper.insert: insert into registration (patient_id, patient_user_id, doctor_id, department, chief_complaint, queue_number) values (#{patientId}, #{patientUserId}, #{doctorId}, #{department}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{queueNumber})
mapper.update: update registration set status = 'in_progress', consultation_time = NOW() where registration_id = #{registrationId}
update registration set status = 'completed', completion_time = NOW() where registration_id = #{registrationId}
update registration set status = 'cancelled' where registration_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.select: select r.*, u.username as patientName from registration r left join patient p on r.patient_id = p.patient_id left join user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} and r.status = 'waiting' order by r.queue_number
